PhD/Medical Thesis

The degree of Doctor of Medicine (MD or DM) thesis is a test more of scientific rather than clinical ability and normally provides some contribution to medical knowledge. The presentation of a dissertation has been one of the requirements for the degree of Doctor of Medicine.

Initially, case reports and reviews of literature predominated, but as the scientific method found its place in medicine, the faculty has required that dissertations presented be based on original investigation either in the laboratory or in the clinic. This experience is considered an important and essential phase of a curriculum which is designed to promote the development of critical judgment, habits of self-education and imagination, as well as the acquisition of knowledge and research skills.

The first evidence that the thesis or dissertation was considered a requirement for the degree of Doctor of Medicine is in a statement in the catalog from 1839, which in part reads, "...the candidate must present a dissertation on some subject connected with the medical sciences.

Hence, the most important quality needed for undertaking such a kind of work is

  • Enthusiasm for original work
  • Studying a subject in-depth

Writing a MD thesis is easier for those who have already written articles and received the criticism of editors. Anyone intending to an MD thesis should follow the below guidelines for successful completion of the program

  • Visit Medical School Library
  • Look at the titles of MD theses
  • Look for professional advice when deciding a research topic for MD thesis
  • Discuss with your guide or an approach should be made to the head of the appropriate department such as medicine, surgery, obstetrics, psychiatry, oncology, immunology, geriatrics, pharmacology, social medicine and so on
  • Check with your dean of the medical school, if necessary
  • Choice of the subject is easiest when the person in engaged with an ongoing research programme
  • Topic must contain sufficient material
  • Check whether you need to obtain University Ethical committee approval

Doctors are recognized formally for their research work at graduation and with a formal publication of the thesis. The Thesis requirement gives added values and make the MD /PhD program more special and help underserved population research encourages students to become leaders in academic endeavours. In general Medical thesis is presented as a formal bound thesis during their final year and must fulfil the following minimal requirements.

Manuscript Medical Thesis requirements

  • Title page,Abstract
  • Introduction / Background
  • Materials and Methods
  • Setting,Sample
  • Inclusion and Exclusion criteria
  • Measurement / Tools
  • Predictors / Independent variables
  • Outcome / Dependent variables
  • Analysis of Data,PResults
  • Discussion,Limitations
  • References,Tables & Graphs

Further in general the thesis will become a formal publication as part of library thesis filling process. In addition students should present their paper at a regional or national meeting or complete the process for publication in peer review journals.
